project: Engenharia Reversa / original REA Linux VPS only
scope: Continue after completed P237 without rerunning historical certifications; harden the existing P237 offline operator comparator, not the original MCP engine.

confirmed_problems: Python dict equality treats JSON true equal to integer 1 and float 1.0 in nested Evidence payloads.
Python JSON parser silently accepts duplicate object keys at top level and inside Evidence.
Nonfinite Infinity was parsed and failed late during re-serialization instead of being rejected at file admission.
Old lstat followed by read_bytes could read a different pathname target after a race.

protections: Type-strict recursive JSON equality, including all nested Evidence/Unknown bodies and manifests.
Reject duplicate JSON object keys and nonstandard nonfinite numeric constants.
Open one file descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW on Linux, check mode and metadata by fstat, use bounded read.
Maintain hardlink/self-comparison, canonical order, Unknown revision chain, and private permission checks from P237.

isolated_regression.runner: Local isolated Linux container, Python 3.13, stdlib unittest, synthetic data only
isolated_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=rea-linux/owner python3 -m unittest discover -s rea-linux/certification/tests -p 'test_rea_p23[78]*.py' -v (equivalent test modules run directly)

actions.reason: Existing Actions workflow only triggers on ops/workflow/new rea-linux/requests/*.json. No MCP request was submitted; no pointless catalog-only run or unauthorized sensitive action performed.

limitations: This offline test does not prove native REA export/import, RFC8785 digest validity, signed recovery, or preservation across live session close.
Use the original REA parser and two independently exported bundles before relying on the offline comparator.

Live retention release requires a separate isolated original-REA fixture, exact Ed25519 owner authorization for any sensitive import/export, full semantic comparison and independent live MCP readback.
